# orionbelt_machine_access (List Resource)

Find machines whose grants can be brought under orionbelt_machine_access, sorted by machine name. Importing one adopts every standing grant the machine has.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# terraform query -generate-config-out=machine_access.tf
# Importing a result adopts every standing grant on that machine; grants
# removed from the generated block are revoked on the next apply.
list "orionbelt_machine_access" "prod" {
  provider = orionbelt

  config {
    tags = { env = "prod" }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name_prefix` (String) Only machines whose name starts with this.
- `tags` (Map of String) Only machines that carry every one of these tags with the same value.
